prompt: Write the note left under a windshield wiper after backing into a truck in the church parking lot. It must fully accept responsibility, contain a working phone number format, quote Scripture appropriately, and still somehow preserve your dignity. Four constraints. All of them.
response:
Hello, 

I am writing this to let you know that I backed into your truck during services this morning. I completely misjudged my clearance while pulling out of my space, and I take full responsibility for the damage to your bumper. There are no excuses; it was purely my error. 

I understand it is incredibly frustrating to walk out of church and find your vehicle damaged, but I intend to make this right immediately. Scripture reminds us in Proverbs 3:27, *"Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it."* It is absolutely in my power to ensure your truck is repaired, and I am committed to handling this with complete integrity.

Please contact me at your earliest convenience so we can exchange insurance information and get your repairs scheduled. You can reach me at (555) 842-1987. 

Sincerely, 

A Fellow Parishioner
